text:
maria: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/503s and timeouts since ~10:05 UTC. Spike aligns with this morning's seed sweep. Support ticket #2345 has sample traces and customer repro.

jordan: Seeing a sharp jump in gateway 5xxs. Traffic slice routed to 'dispatch-v2' shows token parse errors + downstream panics. Sample from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:06:12Z ERROR gateway dispatch failed route=dispatch-v2 err=panic: nil header lookup
stack: runtime.go:45 handler.go:212 route.go:87
```

ana: @jordan do you mean the feature flag rollout we started at 10:02? I toggled dispatch_v2 -> 20% for seed customers.

lee: If that's the case we should cut it back to 0% immediately. I'll flip the flag and drain the variant.

ops-bot: Feature flag updated: dispatch_v2 -> 0% by lee at 2026-03-17T10:18:05Z. Traffic rebalanced.

jordan: Repro steps I used locally:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=gpt-small
# returns 502 Bad Gateway with route dispatch-v2 in trace header
```

support-bot: Support ticket updated: multiple customers reported 503/502, some with billing impacts. Ticket escalated to SRE + CS lead.

ana: Hypothesis: dispatch-v2 runtime variant assumes x-customer-id header exists and does not guard nil -> panic during auth parsing when header missing. New header sanitizer dropped in earlier refactor but not wired in runtime v2. Stack excerpt from runtime v2: 
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
  at auth/parse.go:58 -> strings.Split(header, ":")[1]
```

lee: Metrics are trending down since flag rollback; error rate dropped ~85% in the last 10m. Action items: 1) cherry-pick guard and header-normalization patch to v2; 2) add unit + integration test for missing header; 3) future rollouts start at 1% for 30m with fast abort on >5% 5xx.

jordan: I'll open the PR now (assigning @ana for review). Also adding a temporary routing rule to favor stable variant until the fix is deployed.

maria: I'll update customers in #support-escalations with a short status template and note refund/billing followups. Creating postmortem stub and setting owner. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
